page.title: Build your website in minutes | Oxira
page.description: Design a professional website with Oxira Studio: pick a design, describe your business, and edit it live with an AI designer. Hosting, domain, logo and support included.
page.lead: Pick a design, tell us about your business, and shape your website by chatting with our AI designer while you watch it change live. When you are happy, order it and our system takes it from there.
page.free: Designing is free. You only pay when you order.

steps.name: Choose a design
steps.text: Six professional designs for companies, individuals, restaurants, clinics, stores and events.

steps.name: Tell us about you
steps.text: Your name, what you do and how to reach you. The AI writes your first version in seconds.

steps.name: Edit by chatting
steps.text: Ask for changes in your own words: colours, text, sections, language. See every change instantly.

steps.name: Order and launch
steps.text: Choose hosting, domain, logo and support. We publish your site and send you the details.

page.templatesBody: Every design works on phones, supports Arabic and English, and can be changed completely with the AI designer.
page.includedBody: Choose what you need. Prices are in Saudi riyals and exclude 15% VAT.
page.accountBody: After ordering you get an Oxira account where you can follow your projects, renewals and support requests, and come back to edit your website with the AI designer.
page.ctaTitle: Your website could be ready today
page.ctaBody: Start designing now. It is free until you decide to order.

site.name: Website design and launch
site.text: Your one-page website, built from your design, fast and mobile-ready.

hosting.name: Hosting
hosting.text: Fast, secure hosting with SSL and daily monitoring.

domain.name: Domain name
domain.text: Your own address, such as yourname.com, registered and connected.

support.name: Technical support
support.text: Content updates and support whenever you need them.

logo.name: Logo design
logo.text: A professional logo designed for your brand, in all formats.

studio.pageDescription: Design your website with Oxira's AI designer and see it live.
studio.pickTitle: Choose a design to start with
studio.pickBody: You can change colours, text, fonts and even the design itself later.
studio.basicsBody: A few details and the AI designer writes your first version.
studio.name: Name on the website

suggestions: Change the colours to navy and gold

studio.domainNote: We check availability and confirm the price before registering. Saudi .sa domains need a commercial registration and take a few extra days.
